subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add all-Space-message ingestion via user OAuth or Workspace Events subscriptions, and what consent, scope, and subscription model is acceptable?
rationale: Source review proves the missing capability, but accepting it changes credential storage, OAuth scopes, event-subscription ownership, and which Space messages OpenClaw can see.

options.title: Approve Security-Reviewed Plugin Design
options.body: Define the OAuth or Workspace Events credential model, scopes, SecretRef/redaction behavior, subscription lifecycle, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Limit Core Plugin To Mention Webhooks
options.body: Keep the official plugin on service-account interaction events and document that all-message Space ingestion is not supported today.

options.title: Defer To External Plugin
options.body: Ask for a separate ClawHub or external plugin proposal if maintainers do not want this broader Google Chat data-visibility surface bundled.

recommendation.title: Approve Security-Reviewed Plugin Design
recommendation.body: Define the OAuth or Workspace Events credential model, scopes, SecretRef/redaction behavior, subscription lifecycle, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.
